explanation: From main: The thirteen App-rendering tests await preloadAppViews() in a beforeAll, because App now renders its views as lazy chunks and these tests query them synchronously; the merge with main keeps its deletion of the Statistics and Data Sources tests and its removal of the Compare-as-bars mock. lazyView.test.tsx covers the fallback, synchronous render after preload, no remount when the chunk lands, and a failed download that is reported once and retried only on the boundary reset. originHealth.test.ts expects the HEAD probe. From the cross-study listing: crossStudyListing.test.ts pins the listing in tables: lead and rest per mode and order, counts, dataset rules, flat rows, missing and non-finite keys, stable ties on subsets and no mutation. Report, preview, index and condition-card fixtures now build rows through geneRow / pathwayRow so no fixture contradicts its tier. searchPage adds a lowest-p versus lowest-q case, pathwayReportResults an FDR-mode survivors-first case, and crossDatasetSummary.test.ts goes with summarizeGroup.
